name: OpenAI Codex CLI
install: Install Node.js, then run: npm install -g @openai/codex
login: Run "codex login" once in a terminal and sign in.

name: Gemini CLI
install: Install Node.js, then run: npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
login: Run "gemini" once in a terminal and sign in.

name: goose
login: Run "goose configure" once in a terminal and choose an AI provider (a local one such as Ollama keeps your data on this computer).
